what: Vertically linked rows (talk bubbles, strength cards) stick one after another 100px from the top of the screen. While the next row’s top edge rises to the same spot, the previous row shrinks to .9 around its top edge and fades (linear), and from the .3 point of that range an 8px blur turns on over .6 (scrub .75) — a stack where rows already read sink back and make room for the next. Sticking applies only on wide screens (897px and up), sinking at all widths

options.top: Sticking position (px or a unit like vw), default 100px — Bold 84px (5.8333vw)
options.blur-at: Start point of the range where blur turns on (0~1), default .3
options.blur-dur: Length of the range where blur turns on (0~1), default .6
options.scrub: Follow delay (s), default .75 · true means immediately
options.min: Minimum window width (px) at which it sticks, default 897 — 0 means it sticks at every width
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Rows to stick and stack (children) — needs two or more to rotate. Paint a background so later rows don’t show through
options.span: next (default — until the next line arrives at the same spot) · parent (while its own cell’s top edge passes −top above the screen and rises one more screen — a stacked plate whose cells stretch to the grid end)
options.origin: Axis it shrinks on (transform-origin), default center top — the original Brand is center 25%
options.top: center: Each row sticks to the screen center at its own height — it sinks from when the row’s center touches the screen center until the next row’s center touches it
options.ease: Sinking curve (GSAP name), default none — Brand uses power1.in
